cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(goose_crypto_native LANGUAGES C)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(SODIUM REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libsodium>=1.0.18)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(goose_crypto_native STATIC native/crypto.c native/ranges.c)
set_target_properties(goose_crypto_native PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(goose_crypto_native PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_compile_options(goose_crypto_native PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(goose_crypto_native PUBLIC PkgConfig::SODIUM Threads::Threads)
